# FreeImage <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
FreeImage:Void image:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image to free. |

## Description

Releases an image and its video memory. The handle must not be used afterwards.

## Differences

* Freeing a handle that is 0 or was already freed does nothing, while other commands stop with an error when they get such a handle.
* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the image is freed already, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks). The 0 of an image that failed to load is an error too.
